classification: Actual CLI agent launch routing, safe replay identity and old-host refusal
rationale: Retain all 11 declarations and six explicit table rows. Verify printed recovery identity is the one actually dispatched, require structured compatibility error codes, and restore process.exitCode with failure-safe teardown. Runtime clients and child process endpoints remain mocked.

cases.title: starts an agent in the current worktree through agent.launch
cases.reason: Actual CLI current-worktree resolution must send the independent model, effort, prompt, background presentation, resolved identity and CLI launch source through agent.launchReplay, then print the chosen receipt reason.

cases.title: switches to the new tab only with --focus
cases.reason: Parsed --focus must select focused presentation through the mocked launch RPC; no actual tab or native window is shown.

cases.title: honors the paired execution host for agent launch
cases.reason: A paired server selector must choose that execution host and explicit folder identity without consulting local folder listing.

cases.title: returns an exact recovery command and removes blind retry advice after a lost reply
cases.reason: Lost replies must print unknown launch outcome, retrySafe and exact recovery argv without blind restart advice. Now tie the printed recovery identity to the exact single launchReplay request; a fresh identity only in the recovery record is unsafe.

cases.title: rejects an invalid retry identity before launching: %j
cases.reason: Both missing and whitespace retry identities must reject as invalid_argument mentioning retry-launch before any RPC.

cases.title: keeps recovery identity when an older replacement host refuses a replay method
cases.reason: An old replacement host refusing replay must retain the explicit operation identity and no-fresh-launch guidance. Now assert that the exact single launchReplay RPC carried that original identity.

cases.title: uses the caller folder identity after validating its native host and enclosing path
cases.reason: Inherited local caller folder identity must beat a deeper folder match only after actual local-host/path ownership checks; no worktree lookup is permitted.

cases.title: ignores an inherited remote folder identity and uses the local Git fallback
cases.reason: An inherited SSH folder identity must not select a remote folder on a local command; actual current Git worktree fallback must determine the launch target.

cases.title: refuses on a host older than agent.launch instead of opening a terminal
cases.reason: A host without launch capability must print incompatible_runtime plus independent upgrade/refusal guidance before any launch or creation; require the parsed error code instead of substring alone.

cases.title: refuses a model on a host older than agent.launch rather than dropping it
cases.reason: A chosen model must be refused on an older host with incompatible_runtime before any worktree creation or launch; preserve the requested model and no-agent side-effect checks.

cases.title: refuses %j before creating anything
cases.reason: All four effort/model/agent/surface invalid combinations retain their independently expected validation guidance and zero RPC calls.
